transactions.citation: Year in Review, Jul 2023: 'Completed the divestments of Subang 1 and Chee Wah in Malaysia... Sale price MYR50.2 million (S$14.5 million), Premium to Valuation 6.1%.' Audited Divestments table (p48): 'Chee Wah | Malaysia | MYR50.2 million (S$14.5 million) | MYR47.3 million (S$13.7 million) | 10 July 2023 / Subang 1 | | | | 13 July 2023' (Subang 1's Sale Price/Valuation cells blank in the audited table).
transactions.notes: BUNDLED DEAL: Chee Wah and Subang 1 are disclosed as a single combined sale/valuation figure covering both properties (MYR50.2m sale / MYR47.3m valuation, S$14.5m/S$13.7m); the audited Divestments table (p48) leaves Subang 1's individual Sale Price and Valuation cells blank. Both properties therefore SHARE the same deal_id (m44u:chee_wah_subang_1:divestment:2023) and repeat the same deal-level reference_value and gain_loss_pct, per SPEC's aggregate-deal convention. gain_loss_pct is DISCLOSED (not derived, contrary to the general M44U p48-table pattern): the AR's Year in Review timeline (a different section of the same report) explicitly states 'Premium to Valuation 6.1%' for this bundled divestment, even though the audited p48 table itself carries no % column. Cross-check: (50.2-47.3)/47.3 = 6.13%, consistent with the disclosed 6.1%. Sold to Sigma Warehousing Sdn Bhd; independently valued by Appraisal (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd as at 1 Oct 2022 (income capitalisation and direct comparison methods). Per-property gain_on_divestment and net_sale_proceeds not disclosed (aggregate divestment loss of S$39k across all seven completed FY23/24 divestments is disclosed at Note 14(b)/15, p195, not per-property).
